items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: the teppan they used to yell me at, Ramport and Julian

ctx.x: What about the volume on the different trumpet players? How loud did they play?

Well, the loudest one you mean honey? Mm-hmm. Well, I don't know, but the teppan they used to yell me at, Ramport and Julian, I played at National Park, that's there in Willow. I don't know how loud I was playing, but they said they could yell me at night. So Louis Armstrong himself told me I was about as loud a fella that had in New Orleans, 10 times. Loud, strong, you know.
Were you as loud as Geppin?
